skills.summary: Build a usable color palette with roles
skills.job: Turn a mood or brand seed into a palette with named roles, tints and checked contrast.
triggers: what colors go with this blue
gotchas: Picking hues without assigning roles
Skipping dark-mode or tint steps
Trusting hex values that were never contrast tested

skills.summary: Pick and pair fonts with a type scale
skills.job: Choose a heading and body font pair with a size scale and licence check for a given use.
triggers: pick a font for my site
gotchas: Pairing two display faces that fight
Ignoring licence and web loading cost
Recommending fonts without checking they exist in the needed weights

skills.summary: Write a design brief for a logo
skills.job: Capture who, what, tone and constraints into a logo brief a designer or image tool can act on.
gotchas: Describing a drawing instead of the problem
No list of where the logo will appear
Copying a competitor's look by naming it

skills.job: Draw a simple icon as SVG code on a fixed grid with consistent strokes and a rendered check.
triggers: make an icon for this button
gotchas: Mixed stroke widths and corner styles inside one set
Hard-coded colors that break theming
Never rendering the file to look at it

skills.job: Structure a short brand guidelines doc covering voice, logo use, color, type and imagery rules.
gotchas: Rules with no do and don't examples
Copying values that are not decided yet
Making it a 60 page doc nobody opens

skills.summary: Define a moodboard before collecting images
skills.job: Turn a vague feeling into keywords, references to find and a board structure with annotations.
gotchas: Collecting images before naming the feeling
Mixing references from conflicting eras
Using images with unclear reuse rights in final work

skills.summary: Plan an infographic from data and message
skills.job: Pick the single message, chart types and reading order for an infographic before any layout.
triggers: turn this data into an infographic
what should go in my infographic
gotchas: Several messages competing in one image
Decorative charts that distort values
Sources and dates left off the graphic

skills.summary: Review slides for clarity and design
skills.job: Check a deck for one idea per slide, hierarchy, legibility and consistency, with specific fixes.
triggers: why do my slides look bad
gotchas: Judging content when asked about design
Per-slide notes with no deck-level pattern
Fixes that need a redesign when a template tweak would do

skills.summary: Lay out a poster with clear hierarchy
skills.job: Define size, grid, focal point, text blocks and print specs for a poster or flyer.
triggers: where should the text go on this poster
gotchas: Designing at screen size without print bleed
Too many equally loud text blocks
Body text too small for reading distance

skills.job: Write a precise prompt with subject, style, composition and exclusions, then refine from results.
triggers: help me prompt for this picture
gotchas: Piling adjectives instead of one clear composition
Asking for readable text inside the image
Naming living artists or brands to copy their style

skills.summary: Check color contrast against WCAG ratios
skills.job: Compute contrast ratios for color pairs and propose the nearest passing adjustments.
gotchas: Checking only body text, not icons and borders
Missing hover, disabled and focus states
Rounding 4.4 up to 4.5

skills.job: Critique one design against its goal and audience, in ranked, actionable points.
gotchas: Personal taste presented as flaws
Praise and problems blended into mush
Feedback with no link to the stated goal

skills.job: List sizes, safe zones, text limits and file formats for a set of social graphics, checked live.
gotchas: Quoting platform sizes from memory
Putting text where the UI covers it
One crop forced onto every platform

skills.summary: Derive a UI style guide from existing files
skills.job: Read a codebase or design files and write down the real colors, type, spacing and component rules in use.
triggers: build a style guide from my code
what colors and fonts do we use
gotchas: Writing the ideal system instead of the shipped one
Listing every one-off value as a token
Not reporting inconsistent duplicates

skills.summary: Sketch low-fidelity wireframes in text or SVG
skills.job: Draw a screen layout as ASCII or simple SVG with labelled regions and flows before visual design.
triggers: sketch a layout for my app
gotchas: Adding color and fonts too early
Skipping empty, error and loading states
Inventing content instead of using placeholder labels

skills.summary: Brief a video or article thumbnail
skills.job: Define the one focal subject, text, contrast and crop tests for a thumbnail that reads small.
gotchas: Text unreadable at phone size
Promising something the content does not deliver
Cluttered faces, arrows and badges together
